verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same. The only difference is that the tilted FREE DELIVERY badge sits a few pixels higher in B. Both have the same problems. The CTA 'Find It Near You' is pushed to the top-right corner, above and beside the headline, so the reading order is wrong. The CTA, the two pills and the tilted badge are stacked in one column, so the button reads as just another badge. The body copy is shrunk to tiny text wedged into the bottom-right corner, right against the canvas edge. The product circle is cut off at the bottom edge, leaving the left half cramped against empty gaps.
